[
  "Complete excision of the entire lesion with a narrow margin of 1‑3 mm is recommended when melanoma is suspected.",
  "Incisional biopsies are acceptable for large lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral skin, and genitalia.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be determined based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor when indicated.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible."
